note: The rows are sentences of the pattern's keyboard interaction and notes, quoted as they are. `node scripts/generate-overlay-vectors.mjs --check-source` fetches the pinned page and fails if a quote is not in it (after the markup is removed and the whitespace is made one space). Nothing else here is the pattern's: the vectors are generated from the rows by the script.

rows.opens: When a dialog opens, focus moves to an element inside the dialog.
rows.tab-next: Moves focus to the next tabbable element inside the dialog.
rows.tab-wrap: If focus is on the last tabbable element inside the dialog, moves focus to the first tabbable element inside the dialog.
rows.shift-tab-previous: Moves focus to the previous tabbable element inside the dialog.
rows.shift-tab-wrap: If focus is on the first tabbable element inside the dialog, moves focus to the last tabbable element inside the dialog.
rows.returns: When a dialog closes, focus returns to the element that invoked the dialog unless either:
rows.invoker-gone: The invoking element no longer exists. Then, focus is set on another element that provides logical work flow.
rows.inert: Windows under a modal dialog are inert.
